description: T-4506, T-4664 (c): does Excel for the web refresh, on open, every pivot over one refreshOnLoad cache? Data!A1:B4 is Region/Sales with East =1000 (a formula the case builder caches as missing), West 20, East 5, so a render from the cache shows East 5 and a refresh East 1005. S1!A3 PS1 (Sum of Sales) owns the cache; S1!E3 PS2 (Max of Sales) and S2!A3 PS3 (Count of Sales) share it (one pivotCacheDefinition, the same cacheId). A refreshed PS2 shows East 1000 and PS3 East 2 (a blank record is not counted). Q reads each pivot's body. The pivot cells are also in the sidecar's `pivots` section.
